messages:
ash: heads up — found an anchor loop on runbook docs/runbooks/coldstart.md; clicking the Fast path anchor sends me in a 302 loop back to the top. spotted after the recent anchor rename.
mara: which exact link? can you paste the failing href or a quick snippet?
ash: failing href is /runbooks/coldstart#fast-path -> 302 -> /runbooks/coldstart#intro -> then back to #fast-path. link-checker popped 3 occurrences.
docs-bot: link-checker report: 3 hits found: docs/runbooks/coldstart.md, docs/onboarding/coldstart-quick.md, docs/platform/ops-index.md. run at 2026-03-20T09:10Z. report: https://ci.internal/reports/lnk-607890 (debug/summary attached).
kevin: i'll open a tiny PR to replace the anchor and add frontmatter ownership. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/kb/pull/5823 pinging @mara for review.
mara: sgtm — small asks: add frontmatter owners: ["platform-docs"] and run `mkdocs build --strict` locally before pushing. also add a 1-line changelog in the PR body so ops can track.
jordan: quick question — will this break external shortlinks or redirects?
kevin: no, i'm not touching redirect mappings or canonical URLs, just the in-page anchor text and the internal ref. external shortlinks remain untouched. doing a local verify with sed to preview.
kevin: local preview/patch snippet I used:
```
- [Fast path](#fast-path)
+ [Fast path](#quick-start)
```
sre-oncall: infra side looks fine. CI ran `mkdocs build --strict` on the PR branch and returned:
```
SUCCESS: build completed, 0 warnings, 0 errors
```
mara: LGTM — approving now. kevin please add the owner tag in frontmatter and merge once green. :thumbsup:
kevin: merged and added owners to frontmatter (owners: ["platform-docs"]). CI green. closing the loop, thanks everyone :raised_hands:
ash: thanks all :eyes: — i'll note this in the sprint notes as resolved (docs-bug) and mark the task done in Linear.
